name: Brazilian Tapioca
steps: Use moist, hydrated tapioca starch sold for Brazilian tapioca, or moisten dry tapioca starch gradually until it forms crumbly damp granules; pass through a sieve.
Heat a dry nonstick 20 cm pan over medium-low heat. Sift one quarter of the starch evenly across the base, covering gaps.
Cook 2–3 minutes until the granules bond into a flexible white crepe; do not brown or flip.
Scatter one quarter of the cheese, thin tomato slices, a pinch of salt and oregano on half. Fold over and cook 1 more minute until cheese melts.
Repeat for four crepes and serve immediately while warm and chewy.
tips: Ordinary dry tapioca flour needs hydration and sieving before it will bind in the pan.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
